strings: There's a kind of fuzz in m_c's head as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/go/goes} to r_c0 to complain about losing time between blinks.

Sometimes m_c feels a bit extra fuzzy, and when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stare/stares} off into the distance it feels like no time at all has passed, but then {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/blink/blinks} and the whole world has shifted.
